segments.text: Salathiel was the sonne of Neri by nature: and the sonne of Ieconias legally in regard of succession in the same kingdome. After this manner Zedekias is the brother of Ieconias or Iehoiakin, 2. Chron. 36. 10. and vncle, 2. King. 14. 17. and son, 1. Chro. 3. 16. His brother by generation, and his sonne by the right of succession. On this maner Matthew and Luke are reconciled in the genealogie of Christ. For the one followes the naturall order, as Luke, and the other the legall.
